scripts.name: ICT Killzones & Pivots [TFO]
scripts.author: tradeforopp
scripts.input_contract: Finite completed OHLC, unique increasing timezone-aware DatetimeIndex of bar opens; explicit bar duration. Only aligned single non-full-day session intervals are supported. Optional as_of rejects forming bars; missing bars are never fabricated.
scripts.session_contract: Pine session membership uses bar opens in the configured IANA or fixed GMT timezone. Overnight masks name session end day. Current session extrema are provisional; confirmed_high/low appear at first observed outside-bar close through confirmed_at, never backfilled. Starting inside a session is preserved and flagged partial_session. Consecutive in-session observations belonging to distinct session dates without an observed outside bar are rejected because the source would merge them.
scripts.period_contract: D/W/M require caller-supplied exact aligned boolean exchange timeframe.change flags, including first-row flags. Local New York calendar boundaries are not substituted. D/W/M outputs are absent without these inputs; this is an explicit departure from the Pine UI defaults, whose exchange calendar the local bars do not encode.
scripts.state_contract: Update newest session extrema before detecting strict pivot crossings; track only newest pivot or retained max_days pivots according to extend_which. Range-level touches are inclusive and only counted during their own session. Hits are processed before same-bar cutoff invalidation. Session pivot denominators increment at session START per actual source, despite tooltip text saying end.
scripts.statistics_contract: Average/median use the most recent completed observed session ranges; displacement population standard deviation pools every close minus its session open across retained sessions, updating only at the next session start. All hit counters are causal observation snapshots, not final-chart backfills or profitability estimates.
scripts.port_scope: Enabled session membership, observed extrema and their timestamps, provisional/confirmed session ranges, break conditions and source alert conditions, midpoint touches, causal hit counters, optional range levels, optional exact exchange D/W/M features, exact-time opening prices. Only numeric feature/event outputs; no invented directional trade rule.
omissions: Chart drawings, colors, labels, dashboard placement and last-chart label merging
Text-area color/comment parsing and arbitrary timestamp-only vertical drawings
Historical drawing objects and rendering extension style
Disjoint, full-day and unaligned session schedules
Automatic exchange calendar inference and partial synthetic Pine session bars
Transport behavior of alert.freq_once_per_bar; high/low condition booleans are separate
scripts.admission_status: feature-only; pending exported TradingView fixtures; no active-pool registration

local_validation.coverage: Hand-computed extrema and availability, strict/inclusive crossings, cutoff order, history pruning, range level ticks and session-only tracking, displacement SD pooling, overnight masks, DST versus GMT, exchange period flags, exact opens, partial/gapped sessions, prefix/future invariance, comparison precision, input failures.
